strategies.name: TWAP
strategies.sourceXml:
<Strategy name="TWAP" version="1" wireValue="TWAP" uiRep="TWAP" providerID="SIMULATOR" xmlns="http://www.fixprotocol.org/FIXatdl-1-1/Core">
    <Parameter name="Duration" xsi:type="Int_t" fixTag="7001" use="required" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" />
    <Parameter name="Urgency" xsi:type="Char_t" fixTag="7002" use="optional" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
      <EnumPair enumID="LOW" wireValue="L" />
      <EnumPair enumID="MEDIUM" wireValue="M" />
      <EnumPair enumID="HIGH" wireValue="H" />
    </Parameter>

    <lay:StrategyLayout xmlns:lay="http://www.fixprotocol.org/FIXatdl-1-1/Layout">
      <lay:StrategyPanel title="TWAP Parameters" orientation="VERTICAL" collapsible="false" border="Line">
        <lay:Control ID="c_Duration" xsi:type="lay:TextField_t" parameterRef="Duration" label="Duration (mins)" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" />
        <lay:Control ID="c_Urgency" xsi:type="lay:DropDownList_t" parameterRef="Urgency" label="Urgency" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
          <lay:ListItem uiRep="Low" enumID="LOW" />
          <lay:ListItem uiRep="Medium" enumID="MEDIUM" />
          <lay:ListItem uiRep="High" enumID="HIGH" />
        </lay:Control>
      </lay:StrategyPanel>
    </lay:StrategyLayout>
  </Strategy>
